newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines begins Osaka flights.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines begins Osaka flights.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp announced on Monday it launched nonstop service from Minneapolis to Osaka, one of the largest cities in Japan.
The carrier said it will initially offer three flights per week and increase the flights to a daily schedule as of June 20. The service will operate with Boeing Co 747 jetliners.
Northwest Airlines is the world's fourth-largest carrier and the only airline to operate daily nonstop service from eight U.S. cities to Asia.
Its shares were off 3/16 Monday at 40-9/16.
